fieldValues.title: Shared Coherence and Local Autonomy
fieldValues.content: The standard defaults to **Shared Coherence** for interchange, semantic interpretation, identity, validation, authority, and conformance. It moves toward Local Autonomy when a concern is genuinely presentation-owned, extension-owned, repository-local, or implementation-private. Local variation must remain behind an explicit boundary and must not produce incompatible interpretations of shared data.
